n: Living and Working with AI: Hands-On and Unplugged Activities (CSTA)
t: A CSTA session on teaching AI with unplugged activities from the AI4GA curriculum.
steps: Find the session page in the CSTA resource library.
Log in with a CSTA membership to view the slides.
Find the AI4GA curriculum for the activities.
Read the activity descriptions and choose one for class.
Check whether any activity needs devices or an account.
Gather paper materials for an unplugged activity.
Try the activity with a small group first.
